name: substrate
description: Multi-repo primitive registry: each repo declares its reusable primitives in a substrate.json manifest, a zero-dependency generator compiles them into one SUBSTRATE.md graph — nodes, edges, orphans as dormant value, hubs to harden first — and staleness alarms surface at every session start so new work plugs into what exists instead of running parallel to it. A per-repo deliverables.json ledger rides the same check: anything built but not yet sent alarms at session start until the send is recorded.
